All three dashboard components are ready. Here they are:

## 1. 2025年各省销售额分布 (Provincial Sales Map)


A continuous warm-color map of China keyed on sales volume — the top-5 provinces (广东 ¥15.8M → 北京 ¥7.2M) are shaded by intensity, so the 华东/华南 concentration reads instantly.

## 2. 2025年月度销售额趋势 (Monthly Sales Trend)

```vis-chart
{"type":"area","data":[{"time":"1月","value":1.2},{"time":"2月","value":1.1},{"time":"3月","value":1.4},{"time":"4月","value":1.6},{"time":"5月","value":1.8},{"time":"6月","value":2.1},{"time":"7月","value":2.3},{"time":"8月","value":2.2},{"time":"9月","value":2.5},{"time":"10月","value":2.7},{"time":"11月","value":3.0},{"time":"12月","value":3.5}],"title":"2025年月度销售额趋势","axisXTitle":"月份","axisYTitle":"销售额（百万元）","theme":"academy","width":800,"height":450,"style":{"palette":["#1783FF"],"lineWidth":3}}
```

The area chart makes the acceleration story visible: a soft Jan–Feb dip (¥1.1M low) followed by an almost unbroken climb to a Q4 peak of ¥3.5M in December — nearly 3× the January baseline.

## 3. 广东 vs 江苏：核心品类销售额对比 (Category Comparison)

```vis-chart
{"type":"column","data":[{"category":"电子产品","value":6.2,"group":"广东"},{"category":"电子产品","value":4.8,"group":"江苏"},{"category":"家用电器","value":4.5,"group":"广东"},{"category":"家用电器","value":3.9,"group":"江苏"},{"category":"服装","value":5.1,"group":"广东"},{"category":"服装","value":3.6,"group":"江苏"}],"group":true,"stack":false,"title":"广东 vs 江苏：核心品类销售额对比","axisXTitle":"产品品类","axisYTitle":"销售额（百万元）","theme":"academy","width":800,"height":450,"style":{"palette":["#1783FF","#00C9C9"]}}
```

Grouped (not stacked) so each region's category performance is read side by side. Note the margin patterns worth flagging in your review:

| 品类 | 广东 | 江苏 | 差额 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 电子产品 | 6.2 | 4.8 | +1.4 |
| 家用电器 | 4.5 | 3.9 | +0.6 |
| 服装 | 5.1 | 3.6 | +1.5 |

电子产品 is the strongest category in both regions (+¥0.9M over 服装 in 广东, +¥1.2M in 江苏), while 家用电器 is the laggard in both — and it's also where the two regions are closest, suggesting a shared, structural ceiling rather than a regional execution gap.

**Two notes on the data I received:**
- The five province figures sum to ¥53.4M, but the twelve monthly figures sum to ¥23.4M. I built both charts exactly as specified, but these totals represent very different things — likely the map is full-year all-region revenue while the trend line is a single team or a subset. Worth reconciling before this goes to leadership.
- The category chart covers only 广东 and 江苏 (the only two you provided). I didn't extrapolate the other three provinces, so if this panel is meant to read as a national category comparison, it's missing 浙江/山东/北京 and would understate totals.
